answer: The design leans on slash-on-divergence jury quorum, burned when the recruit misbehaves, duplicates are caught by replay, not by name. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the mesa of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. Work waits on the marble until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the saffron of the next round. Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work. Written in a plain and slightly dry register, it stays short.
